verses.ar:
يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينْ (٣x)
يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينْ ۞ فَرِّجْ عَلٰى الْمُسْلِمِينْ
verses.tr: Yā arḥama-r-rāḥimīn (3x) · Yā arḥama-r-rāḥimīn · farrij ʿalā-l-muslimīn
verses.en: O Most Merciful of the merciful (3x) — O Most Merciful of the merciful, bring relief to the Muslims.

verses.ar: يَا رَبَّنَا يَا كَرِيمْ ۞ يَا رَبَّنَا يَا رَحِيمْ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbanā yā Karīm · yā Rabbanā yā Raḥīm
verses.en: O our Lord, O Generous One; O our Lord, O Merciful One.

verses.ar: أَنْتَ الْجَوَادُ الْحَلِيمْ ۞ وَأَنْتَ نِعْمَ الْمُعِينْ
verses.en: You are the Bestower, the Forbearing — and You are the best of helpers.

verses.ar: وَمَا لَنَا رَبَّنَا ۞ سِوَاكَ يَا حَسْبُنَا
verses.tr: Wa mā lanā Rabbanā · siwāka yā ḥasbunā
verses.en: We have none, our Lord, besides You — O our Sufficiency.

verses.ar: يَا ذَا الْعُلَا وَالْغِنَى ۞ وَيَا قَوِيُّ يَا مَتِينْ
verses.tr: Yā dhā-l-ʿulā wa-l-ghinā · wa yā Qawiyyu yā Matīn
verses.en: O Possessor of highness and all-sufficiency, O Strong One, O Firm One.

verses.ar: وَلَيْسَ نَرْجُو سِوَاكْ ۞ فَأَدْرِكْ إِلَهِي دَرَاكْ
verses.tr: Wa laysa narjū siwāk · fa-adrik ilāhī darāk
verses.en: We hope in none but You — so reach us, my God, with swift rescue,

verses.ar: قَبْلَ الْفَنَا وَالْهَلَاكْ ۞ يَعُمُّ دُنْيَا وَدِينْ
verses.tr: Qabla-l-fanā wa-l-halāk · yaʿummu dunyā wa dīn
verses.en: before ruin and destruction engulf both worldly life and religion.

verses.ar: بِجَاهِ طٰهٰ الرَّسُولْ ۞ جُدْ رَبَّنَا بِالْقَبُولْ
verses.en: For the sake of Taha the Messenger, grant us, our Lord, Your acceptance.

verses.ar: وَهَبْ لَنَا كُلَّ سُولْ ۞ رَبِّ اسْتَجِبْ لِي آمِينْ
verses.tr: Wa hab lanā kulla sūl · Rabbi-stajib lī āmīn
verses.en: Bestow on us all that we ask — my Lord, answer me. Amin.

verses.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِي كُلَّ الذُّنُوبْ ۞ وَاسْتُرْ لِي كُلَّ الْعُيُوبْ
verses.tr: Wa-ghfir lī kulla-dh-dhunūb · wa-stur lī kulla-l-ʿuyūb
verses.en: Forgive me all my sins, and cover all my faults.

verses.ar: وَاكْشِفْ لِي كُلَّ الْكُرُوبْ ۞ وَاكْفِ أَذَى الْمُؤْذِينْ
verses.en: Lift from me every distress, and shield me from the harm of those who harm.

verses.ar: وَاخْتِمْ بِأَحْسَنْ خِتَامْ ۞ إِذَا دَنَا الْاِنْصِرَامْ
verses.en: And seal my life with the best of endings when the departure draws near,

verses.ar: وَحَانَ حَيْنُ الْحِمَامْ ۞ وَزَادَ رَشْحُ الْجَبِينْ
verses.tr: Wa ḥāna ḥaynu-l-ḥimām · wa zāda rashḥu-l-jabīn
verses.en: when the appointed hour arrives and the brow beads with sweat.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامْ ۞ عَلٰى شَفِيعِ الْأَنَامْ
verses.en: Then blessings and peace upon the intercessor of humankind,
and upon his family — the finest of nobles — his companions, and those who followed them.
